contactPage.title: Contact Us
contactPage.subtitle: Official Communication Channel of Celestia
contactPage.description: The PT Mitra Rahim Indonesia marketing team is ready to assist you with inquiries regarding property projects, location survey schedules, and plot consultations.
contactPage.marketingDesc: Reach our marketing team via WhatsApp for prompt responses regarding unit information, plot availability, and site survey appointments.
contactPage.interestFormNotice: Looking to submit specific plot or building type preferences?
contactPage.faq1Question: How do I schedule a project site survey?
contactPage.faq1Answer: You can reach out to our marketing team via WhatsApp to schedule a guided site visit to the Dehir project in Jatiluhur.
contactPage.faq2Question: Can I book or purchase a plot directly through the website?
contactPage.faq2Answer: Currently, the website serves as a promotional and exploration platform. Reservations and availability verifications are handled directly through our marketing team.
contactPage.faq3Question: Is the unit status shown on the website final?
contactPage.faq3Answer: Units without confirmed company status are labeled 'Unknown' for full transparency. Up-to-date availability can be confirmed directly with marketing.
